name: Affinity
description: Affinity lets agents search people, companies, and opportunities, read notes and interaction history, and update lists in the CRM of the signed-in account. Each user signs in to their own Affinity account through the browser.

prompts.text: Who on my team has the strongest connection to this company?
Summarize the deals in my pipeline list that had no contact in 30 days.
Prepare a brief on this founder from our notes and past emails.

apps.name: Affinity
apps.description: CRM search, notes, and list updates, over Affinity's MCP server with browser sign-in.
